g.text: Energy-aware operation: sense, decide, act, place (ASUC-04)
Read carbon intensity, price, renewable flag
Load active policy and current mode
[no valid sample for longer than stale limit]
Classify intensity and price with hysteresis; take the more restrictive class
Renewable available forces GREEN; apply unexpired operator override
Read current mode (pull, cached up to 60 s)
[deadline reached or GREEN or (AMBER and half window left)]
Read observations; store versioned forecast if sanity check passes
